messages:
kavi_peopleops: Quick update 1: Alex R (contractor) submitted notice today. Contract ends Fri 2026-04-10. Need to coordinate: equipment return (SF hub), revoke Okta/VPN, rotate any deploy keys, confirm final invoice/payment, and check Dedicated cluster service accounts. Looping in @toni_it and @ryan_finance.

alexr_contractor: thanks everyone. I'll leave a handover doc in the project folder and tag Priya for ongoing tasks. Happy to do a 20m walkthrough.

nate_manager: please capture any running experiments or checkpoints. Alex, can you list any long-lived tokens or service accounts you used?

alexr_contractor: I used: ci-bot deploy key for repo inference-models, a personal AWS key (will delete after handoff), and a Vault token that expires in 30d. No active training jobs beyond checkpoints.

toni_it: I'll schedule a courier for equipment pickup on Mon 2026-04-13. Laptop + dongles. Will mark pickup attempt in this thread. After pickup and confirmed handoff we'll revoke Okta and VPN certs.

ryan_finance: For contractors: we need a final invoice + timesheet by EOD Tue 2026-04-07 to hit payroll on Wed 2026-04-15. Please attach a PDF invoice to the offboard ticket. COBRA: contractors not eligible; I'll send a termination confirmation email.

kavi_peopleops: Offboarding checklist (initial):
- courier scheduled (toni_it)
- final invoice submitted (alexr_contractor)
- repo/keys audit (nate_manager + toni_it)
- exit interview scheduled (people ops)
- access revocations (toni_it)

offboard-bot: Ticket OFF-4822 created 1: assignees: toni_it, ryan_finance, nate_manager. Due: 3 business days.

toni_it: Commands I'll run after pickup + approval:
```
# remove from org & audit keys
./ops/remove_user.sh --user alexr
vault list-access --user alexr | xargs vault revoke
# rotate CI/deploy keys
./ops/rotate-deploy-keys.sh inference-models
```

toni_it: Note: We hold deprovision for 48h to allow scheduled knowledge transfer calls.

nate_manager: I'll reassign open PRs and add reviewers. If any cron jobs reference alexr's tokens I'll update them today.

alexr_contractor: submitted invoice (attached to OFF-4822). Also dropped the handoff doc at /shared/handoffs/alexr-handoff.md.

ryan_finance: Received invoice, thanks. Marking for the 2026-04-15 run. Will confirm once payment posts.

kavi_peopleops: Scheduling exit interview: Wed 2026-04-08 11:00 PST. Please join if you had direct work with Alex.

toni_it: After revocation I'll post timestamps and list of removed entitlements here.

kavi_peopleops: Thanks team 10. Closing loop after OFF-4822 shows all tasks complete.
